full_page.content:
1952 January 1
The following is a faithful transcription of a message written on a Seraphic Mass Association card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
Seraphic Mass Association, 210 W. 31 St. New York 1
Joseph O'Donnell for God's holy guidance in his many problem - together with his associates New Years Day January Ist 1952 God bless you Joseph J. - you and yours - Now and in Eternity! Fr. Solanus, OFM Cap.
requested by - His Wife Winnie
After all, if the saints have found +++++ and sorrows to bring them closer to Jesus - and they must be so short - why fear to embrace them ! ? ! Fr. Solanus.
